title: cyperella campestris
intro: Cyperella campestris, commonly known as earthball mushroom, is a species of fungus in the family Lycoperdaceae. This edible and medicinal mushroom has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antitumor and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperella campestris include its ability to stimulate the production of white blood cells, which play a crucial role in fighting infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of this mushroom include polysaccharides, glycoproteins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
